static-method-declarations.desc: The component declares > 100 static methods that reduce dependency management capabilities and testability. The goal is to reduce this number significantly.

funding.summary: The number of static methods has been reduced to 70.

large-classes.desc: The component includes > 20 code classes with > 500 lines of code each. This usually violates single responsibility principles and makes the code harder to read and test. The goal is to reduce this number significantly.
